title: Interventions, 1898-1933: Cuba, Panama and the marines
goal: I can tell how the United States intervened in Cuba, Panama, Nicaragua, Haiti and the Dominican Republic, using cuando and mientras.
grammar: cuando and mientras with past tenses

items: I can say what happened after the war of 1898.
I can say what the Platt Amendment allowed.
I can tell when the marines arrived in Nicaragua and Haiti.
I can link two past events with *cuando* and *mientras*.
I can link events in the past with *cuando* and *mientras*.
I can say what happened to Cuba and Puerto Rico after 1898.
I can say how Panama and the canal were linked.
I can name the countries where US marines arrived.
I can say who Sandino was.
